basic_details.scholarship_name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
basic_details.offering_entity: Swedish Institute (SI) & Government of Sweden (Ministry for Foreign Affairs)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: All Swedish Universities participating in national admissions (KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Chalmers, Lund, Uppsala, Stockholm University, Karolinska Institutet, Gothenburg, Linköping)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to ~700 eligible English-taught Master's degree programs aligned with the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development (Sustainability, Climate, Engineering, CS, Public Health, Human Rights, Business).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~350 scholarships awarded annually across 41 eligible countries
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan as an eligible partner country (~15 to 25 Pakistani scholars selected annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 1 to 2 academic years (full duration of the Master's program: 60 or 120 ECTS credits)

nationality_requirements: Citizen of an eligible country (including Pakistan)
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 16 years of education (4-year Bachelor's degree or 2-year Bachelor's + 2-year Master's) satisfying Swedish university entrance requirements.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA; must meet specific academic prerequisites for chosen Swedish Master's program.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Eligible Master's program in an approved subject area aligned with sustainable development.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated and currently employed or having substantial past employment.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: MANDATORY: Minimum 3,000 hours of documented work experience (equivalent to approximately 1.5 to 2 years full-time) prior to the deadline, plus demonstrated leadership experience.

english_proficiency.notes: Must meet Swedish University Admissions English 6 requirement: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band below 5.5) or TOEFL iBT 90 (writing 20).

eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Demonstrated leadership experience, commitment to UN Sustainable Development Goals, and potential to contribute to positive development in Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Ineligible if previously awarded an SI scholarship for master's study, or if currently holding a degree from a Swedish university.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full international tuition fee paid directly by the Swedish Institute to the host Swedish university.

admission_application_fee.details: University Admissions Sweden application fee (SEK 900, ~PKR 25,000) paid by applicant.

monthly_stipend.details: Regular monthly living allowance paid throughout the study period.
monthly_stipend.amount: SEK 12,000 / month (~PKR 330,000 / month or SEK 144,000 / year)

airfare.details: One-time travel grant paid upon arrival in Sweden.

visa_fee.details: Swedish residence permit application fee (SEK 1,500) paid by student.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health and accident insurance (Kammarkollegiet) provided by the Swedish state.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Full membership in the SI Network for Future Global Professionals (NFGP) and SI Alumni Network with funded workshops.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Apply for up to 4 eligible Master's programs across any Swedish universities via University Admissions.
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 100 European research powerhouses and technology institutes.
available_majors: Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Sustainable Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Sciences, Public Health, Environmental Management, Economics, International Development, Sustainable Business
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Two-step process: First apply for master's programs on University Admissions Sweden; then apply for the SI scholarship using your application number.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must be admitted to an eligible program by late March to be awarded the scholarship.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Check the official SI list of eligible master's programs; select programs that directly correspond to your documented work experience.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for master's programs at universityadmissions.se (October to mid-January). Step 2: Apply for SI scholarship on SI portal (mid-February).
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Apply for up to four eligible Master's programs on UniversityAdmissions.se by January 15.
2. Pay the university application fee (SEK 900) and upload transcripts by February 1.
3. Prepare official SI forms: Work Experience Certificate, Leadership Certificate, and Reference Letters (strict SI templates only).
4. Apply on the SI scholarship portal during the 10-day application window in mid-February.
5. Admissions results announced on UniversityAdmissions.se in late March.
6. If admitted to an eligible program, SI announces scholarship recipients in late April.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Two separate applications: University application on central Swedish portal; scholarship application on SI portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by candidate using mandatory SI reference letter template with official stamps.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Address your leadership experience, how the master's program connects to your work, and how you will advance sustainable development in Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Motivation questions answered directly on the online portal.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Mandatory Swedish Institute Europass-based CV template (maximum 3 pages; other CV formats disqualify applicant).
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; decisions based entirely on rigorous assessment of written documentation and verified certificates.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: SEK 900 for University Admissions; $0 for SI scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Transcripts attested by HEC Pakistan uploaded to UniversityAdmissions.se.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed strictly on the mandatory SI CV template (max 3 pages)
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Any other CV format results in automatic disqualification

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Proof of Work and Leadership Experience
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official SI template completed and stamped by employers verifying 3,000+ hours
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed and stamped by employers in Pakistan; verifiable contact info required

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed strictly on the official SI template (one from work, one from leadership)
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must have referee signature and official organization stamp
Valid for at least the duration of intended study

required_documents_checklist.specification: Answers to SI motivation prompts focusing on UN SDGs
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clear narrative on sustainability challenges in Pakistan

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: University admissions deadline is mid-January; SI scholarship portal is open for only ~10-14 days in mid-February each year.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Admission to an eligible Swedish university Master's program)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 25% (Demonstrated leadership track record in profession or community)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Swedish Institute selection committee, external evaluators, and Swedish development experts.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase: Phase 1 assesses work experience and leadership relevance; Phase 2 verifies university admission.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Professionals with 3 to 7 years of substantive experience in tech, clean energy, public health, or NGOs with clear leadership roles.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Mid-career Pakistani engineers, public policy analysts, healthcare professionals, environmental activists.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Kenya, Ghana, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Websites offering fake SI work experience templates or claiming to sell verified forms.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: SI scholarship application is 100% free; university application fee on UniversityAdmissions.se is SEK 900.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Swedish Institute strictly audits work certificates; fraudulent certificates result in immediate police report and permanent ban.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Initial pocket money before first stipend transfer in Sweden.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You can use your own CV format. (Fact: You MUST use the official SI CV template; any other format is disqualified).
MYTH: Fresh graduates with zero work experience can apply. (Fact: 3,000 hours of documented work experience is an absolute requirement).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Many blogs state work experience can be self-certified; officially, all hours must be stamped by employers on official templates.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must pass at least 45 ECTS credits per academic year (out of 60 ECTS).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical studies on campus in Sweden.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host universities report credits earned each semester to the Swedish Institute.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: There is no legal limit on work hours for student visa holders in Sweden, but SI expects full-time dedication to studies.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return rule; scholars can apply for a 1-year residence permit to seek employment or start a business in Sweden post-graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: None; commitment to engage with the SI Alumni Network.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failing to obtain minimum required credits leads to suspension or withdrawal of scholarship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarships cannot be extended beyond the official duration of the program.
